claims.statement: The council approved up to EUR 40,000 for the energy center, subject to legal review.
claims.source_span: Der Rat genehmigt für das Energiezentrum höchstens 40.000 EUR. Die Freigabe gilt vorbehaltlich der rechtlichen Prüfung.

claims.statement: The proposed energy-center budget is EUR 60,000.
claims.source_span: Le budget proposé pour le centre énergétique est de 60 000 EUR.

claims.statement: Approval is valid only after legal review.
claims.source_span: L'approvazione è valida solo dopo il controllo legale.
